sentences.en: A time will come when you will regret your action.
sentences.zh: 你总有一天会为自己的行为后悔。

sentences.en: The police took immediate action to deal with the riot.
sentences.zh: 警方迅速采取行动平息了骚乱。

sentences.en: It is hard to embody one's idea in an action.
sentences.zh: 要把想法付诸行动很难。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：act（做）+ion（表名词）→行为
